eConsent Instructions

The REDCap eConsent is a template to be used for those who have approval from the IRB to collect the informed consent documentation electronically. This template is intended to be customized to each study. Fields that do not apply to the protocol should be removed (deleted). Treat each database as a study-specific binder. Each study should have its own database and should not contain information from another study. For more, go to eConsent Process Guide. *This field can only be viewed in the Online Designer and is not seen in the data entry form or survey.
